##### Project general facts

Elinor by Zoya is a thoughtfully designed residential development that reflects modern architecture, clean lines and functional living spaces. It offers a collection of contemporary studios and two-bedroom residences created to support comfortable urban lifestyles, with every detail carefully considered to combine practicality with elegance and a focus on long-term value and everyday convenience.

The development features a range of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance daily living, including a swimming pool, an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a kids' playground, a barbecue area and landscaped spaces for relaxation. Residents also benefit from EV charging stations, direct access to park areas and dedicated visitor parking, creating a well-rounded environment where comfort, leisure and convenience come together.

Residences are delivered fully furnished with modern finishing in high-quality materials. Interiors feature practical layouts and stylish fittings, kitchens come equipped with appliances, and the complete furnishing concept allows residents to enjoy a hassle-free living experience from the moment they move in.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a strategically planned district in the southern part of Dubai, conceived as a major hub for economic, commercial and logistics activity. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, one of the world's largest airports by cargo volume, makes the district a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

Dubai South is home to the Expo City Dubai legacy district, which offers residential communities, educational institutions and recreational facilities alongside world-class event infrastructure. Green initiatives, eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings underline the district's commitment to sustainable living.

Dubai South is a thriving business and residential hub that attracts both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for end users and investors alike, supported by the ongoing economic diversification of Dubai.
